post.description:
Exchange a service-account token for a bearer JWT issued for a software-agent identity.

The caller authenticates at the knowledge base's trusted issuer as its own service account and presents that token here; it must carry `semiont-service` in a flat `roles` claim. What comes back names a (provider, model) agent identity, which is a different thing from the caller: one worker process holds several agent identities at once when a deployment configures different models for different job types, so the credential and the identity cannot be the same.

The issued JWT carries the agent's DID (shape `did:web:<host>:agents:<provider>:<model>`); the bus stamps that DID onto `_userId` so events the agent emits attribute to the agent rather than to a generic worker pool.

token.description: Bearer JWT for subsequent authenticated requests

did.description: DID of the software-agent identity the token is acting as

401.description: Missing, unverifiable, or insufficiently privileged caller token. Also the answer when this knowledge base trusts no issuer: configuration state is not an unverified caller's business.
